The reaction typically proceeds via a concerted mechanism, where the pi electrons of the diene and dienophile interact to form new sigma bonds. The reaction can be catalyzed by heat or Lewis acids, and the regioselectivity of the product can be influenced by substituents on the diene and dienophile.
